Title: General availability: Start/Stop VMs during off-hours in Azure Automation

Body.Content:
The Start/Stop VMs during off-hours solution starts and stops your Azure virtual machines on user-defined schedules, provides insights through Azure Log Analytics, and sends optional emails by using action groups (email functionality not available in Government subscriptions). It supports both Azure Resource Manager and classic deployment models for VMs in most scenarios. 

 These updates are part of making this solution generally available:

  • All dependent modules are updated to the latest available versions.
  • This solution is now available in Government subscriptions.
  • This solution can now be deployed from Azure Automation under the Related Resources section.

For more information, please see Start/Stop VMs during off-hours in Azure Automation production documentation.
